det.doc: Maps (canonical ingredient code + preparation STATE) → a food-safety advisory that applies ONLY in that state (Future-Features SAFE — founder chose the prep/state context). E.g. `huevo` + `crudo` → salmonella caution; `porotos` + `crudo` → toxina danger. Content is PROVENANCE-TAGGED via `source_kind` (`official` | `ai_default`), `source_ref` NOT NULL — same two-tier disclosure as IngredientWarning. Rows ship ahead of the recipe-level trigger: a rule fires into a recipe's `avisos` when that recipe uses the ingredient in `state_tag` (the state signal is wired in a follow-up; the table + content come first). System-owned.
A dietary preference entry for soft filter (D17).
Queue of UNKNOWN (unresolved) ingredient names seen on generated recipes (#39 / D72).
Maps a canonical ingredient code → an allergen-restriction code it BREAKS (R8 / #38).

Maps a canonical ingredient code → an INTRINSIC food-safety advisory it carries (Future-Features SAFE). A SOFT advisory — *how not to mishandle* (e.g. "los porotos crudos contienen fitohemaglutinina; hervir 10 min") — kept DISTINCT from the HARD allergen wall in `IngredientRestriction` (*who can't eat*). Content is PROVENANCE-TAGGED (founder D-PH-1 revised): `source_kind` is `official` (an authoritative citation in `source_ref`, e.g. FDA/MINSAL/WHO) or `ai_default` (no official source found — the advisory is an AI-suggested default and the UI DISCLOSES it as such). `source_ref` stays NOT NULL. `aviso_code` is the stable id surfaced in the derived `recipes.avisos`. System-owned.
An allergen/restriction entry for hard SQL filter (D17).
Two-section dietary profile (D108): allergens[] (hard SQL filter) + preferences[] (soft).
A cooking household — the tenant boundary for pantry, recipes, shopping.
Tracks an in-flight or completed multi-write operation for retry safety.
Links a user to a household with a role (primary_cook | co_cook).
Tracks whether a user has completed first-run setup. One row per user.
A user's current subscription tier (free | chef). One row per user.
A person, identified provider-agnostically (Firebase today, portable tomorrow).
A cook-photo binary attached to a cooking session (H8, founder-ratified D144).
An active or completed cooking session.
Durable per-stage reminder for a long-prep cooking session (REQ-16 / SC-07).
Per-step progress within a cooking session.
Append-only dish history — feeds profile aggregates.
A user notification — read/delete state is user-owned.
Cached profile summary for fast Perfil landing (Batch 7).
A single acceptance of the privacy policy + terms, at a policy version.
An unmappable receipt item awaiting admin review.
Append-only ingredient history — source is compra/receta/descarte.
A storage location in a household. Exactly one principal `Despensa` is protected.
A current-state inventory row — what is believed to exist in the household pantry.
Per-item decision in a reset operation: keep / discard / move.
A pantry reset operation — scope + summary. Idempotency-required.
Idempotency record for a receipt-ingest run (ent posture).
A shopping list item — household-scoped, status lifecycle.
Per-user RAW progression signal on a node (roast M2/M3).
A user's progress toward learning one technique or ingredient (REQ-14).
A progression tree (config) — one per kind (technique, region, diet, flavor).
A prerequisite/suggests edge between nodes — EMPTY at MVP (roast M5); here for the DAG.
A node in a tree — one taxonomy code, seeded from the taxonomy (M5 pure extractor).
One real Gemini call's cost, summed over a rolling window for the spend cap (#41).
A canonical ingredient entry. Referenced by pantry items (Batch 3+).

Maps a NON-canonical ingredient name (normalized) → an existing canonical code (Phase 33 / #39 / D72). Populated by the reconciliation script as live Gemini codes are triaged; the resolver consults it so a future occurrence auto-resolves. `alias_normalized` is the natural PK (one canonical per alias); `canonical_code` FKs the canonical set.
An ingredient category (vegetables, proteins, dairy, etc.).
A measurement unit (g, kg, ml, cup, etc.).
A recipe planned for cooking — household-scoped.
A recipe — system-seeded, user-created (manual), or Gustify AI generated.
A recipe creation request — manual or Gustify AI.

Captured DEMAND from a 0-result recipe search (2026-06-22). When a search returns nothing, the user can explicitly ask Gustify to create recipes for it: we record the UNMET SEARCH (the filter selection that returned 0) + an optional ≤140-char note, for later ON-DEMAND authoring — NOT real-time generation. status: pending → fulfilled. household nullable (context only).
A critical piece of equipment a recipe needs (Phase 9 / SCHEMA-ENRICH, migration 0044).
One saved recipe-filter preset for a user (a "slot").
An ingredient line in a recipe.
A text note attached to a recipe.
An ordered step in a recipe.
A taxonomy dimension (e.g. origen, tipo, tecnica, dieta, complejidad, tiempo).
A value within a taxonomy dimension (e.g. 'chile' in origen, 'soup' in tipo).
A piece of equipment the USER owns — the per-user kitchen inventory (H5 / Phase 13a).
Per-user favorite/archived flags for a (platform-shared) recipe (D93, Phase 41c).
Household-owned shared format defaults: country, units, currency, default servings.
User-scoped exploration preferences (Phase 63 / D109 + D109-rev Path A+).
User-owned personal format preference: display language (REQ-17 locale).
User-owned notification category toggles (cooking, shopping, pantry).
User-owned independent privacy toggles (shopping data, culinary prefs, reminders).

fn:allergen|apply_reconciliation.doc: Apply triage decisions to the reconciliation queue. dry_run=True (default) rolls back so the caller can preview (roast S7). 'create' REQUIRES an explicit `violates` list (validated against known restriction codes) so a new ingredient never enters the catalog with silently missing allergen tags. Resolved rows are stamped with status + resolved_by/at (audit, S8).

fn:allergen|avisos_for_ingredient_codes.doc: Collect the deduped avisos for a recipe's ingredient codes — intrinsic + contextual. Deduped by ``aviso_code`` (a recipe with several beans gets the lectin aviso once). Ordered danger-first then by ``aviso_code`` for stable output. Empty list when nothing applies.

fn:allergen|clean_tags.doc: Strip + lowercase + dedupe tag slugs; reject empties and over-cap lists. When ``allowed`` is given, ALLOWLIST-validate every tag against it (#42 / R8) — a mistyped or wrong-vocabulary code is rejected rather than silently providing no protection.

fn:allergen|enqueue_unknown_ingredients.doc: Upsert every UNKNOWN ingredient across the candidates into the reconciliation queue (occurrence_count++). Returns the count of distinct unknowns seen (0 if none). Never raises — best-effort (roast S5).

fn:allergen|reconcile_recipe_restriction.doc: Re-derive restriction_codes from the catalog and UPDATE any DRIFTED slugged recipe row. Returns ``(updated, scanned)`` — updated = rows whose stored codes differed (so a clean DB is a no-op), scanned = catalog recipes with a slug. Idempotent. Testable: tests call it directly. ``files`` defaults to the on-disk catalog; the startup path passes a pre-loaded list.

fn:allergen|seed_recipe_restrictions_on_.doc: Reconcile the R8 allergen wall from the in-image catalog on deploy. TWO closures, both fed by the catalog files (mirrors seed_recipe_sensory_on_startup — DEPLOY-ONLY, advisory-locked, NON-FATAL, so a failure logs LOUDLY but never crash-loops boot): 1. BROWSE path — re-derive each slugged recipe's stored ``restriction_codes`` (drifted rows). 2. AI-GENERATION path — UNION the catalog-delta ingredient→restriction pairs into ``ingredient_restrictions`` (insert-only). ``seed_ingredient_restrictions`` seeds only taxonomy ``starter_ingredients``, so delta-only fin-fish (fish-sauce, congrio, …) otherwise never carry fish-free in that table and the AI wall (``reference.resolution .derive_restrictions``) can't derive it. Insert-only ⇒ idempotent, never removes a pair.

fn:auth|AuthContext.require_household.doc: Return the household, or 409 if the user has not completed setup.

fn:auth|_build_me_response.doc: Build the /me payload from the auth context + preference lookups.

fn:auth|_discard_claim.doc: Remove any surviving claim row after a failed attempt so the key retries clean.

fn:auth|_load_setup_result.doc: Read-only re-derivation of a completed setup graph (REPLAY / already-set-up).

fn:auth|_reclaim.doc: Re-stamp an abandoned claim as a fresh PENDING attempt, in place, so a successful complete() overwrites the stale claim instead of colliding with it.

fn:auth|_subscription_block.doc: Subscription block with the D95 credits surface (allowance + derived remaining).

fn:auth|_upsert_exploration.doc: D109: thin wrapper over the exploration service's get-or-create upsert.

fn:auth|build_auth_context.doc: Verify a raw token, persist the identity, and load the household read-only.

fn:auth|claim.doc: Reserve the key for this operation/owner, or report an existing outcome.

fn:auth|complete.doc: Mark a claimed operation completed with a reference to its stored result.

fn:auth|complete_setup.doc: Idempotently complete setup for ``user``; the service owns commit/rollback.

fn:auth|delete_identity.doc: Delete a user's identity at the configured auth provider (account deletion, 2026-07-09).

fn:auth|delete_me.doc: Delete the caller's account — Settings "Zona de peligro" (founder 2026-07-09).

fn:auth|ensure_principal_household.doc: Ensure the user belongs to a household with a principal Despensa.

fn:auth|ensure_verifier_ready.doc: Validate the configured verifier at startup — fail fast on bad config.

fn:auth|get_auth_context.doc: Verify the bearer token, persist the identity, and load the household read-only.

fn:auth|get_auth_context_from_query.doc: Query-param token auth for SSE (REQ-10 roast M1). Same resolution as the bearer dependency; the token rides the URL because EventSource has no header API.

fn:auth|get_principal_location.doc: Return the household's protected principal `Despensa`, if it exists.

fn:auth|healthz.doc: Liveness probe. Returns ok while the process is serving.

fn:auth|load_household_context.doc: Read-only: the user's household + membership + principal, or None if unset.

fn:auth|resolve_or_create_user.doc: Return the existing user for this identity, or create one.

fn:cooking|EventBus.publish.doc: Run every handler for ``type(event)`` synchronously, in order, ISOLATED.

fn:cooking|_attach_photos.doc: Populate ``resp.photos`` via ONE grouped ``list_photo_refs`` query, and ``resp.recipe_title`` via ONE ``Recipe`` lookup (the active-cook card must never fall back to a placeholder title just because the recipe is off the loaded catalog page) — every CookingSessionResponse constructor site calls this (never N+1, H8).

fn:cooking|_load_owned_session.doc: Ownership-scoped session lookup — user_id AND household_id in one WHERE (D136), mirroring ``update_readiness`` / ``set_session_timer``. ``require_active`` gates uploads/deletes to a mid-cook session; reads pass False (any status — completed cooks keep their photos, reached via session_id from dish history).

fn:cooking|_recipe_titles.doc: ``Recipe.title`` for each id, in ONE query — reused by both the single-response sites (a list of one) and ``get_active`` (the full batch), so neither ever N+1s.

fn:cooking|_replay_completion.doc: Reconstruct an already-completed session's result from its stored summary.

fn:cooking|_resolve_storage_method.doc: Pick the storage method for a stored portion: the user's choice, else the recipe's first hint (Phase 69), else fridge. Unknown/absent codes fall through so we never store a phantom.

fn:cooking|_schedule_next.doc: Schedule the reminder for stage (from_stage+1), due anchor + stages[from_stage].hold_hours. Returns None at the terminal stage (nothing after the last).

fn:cooking|advance_stage.doc: Advance a long-prep session one stage. Optimistically concurrent: only advances when ``expected_stage`` matches the session's current stage, so a retry/double-tap is a safe no-op replay (returns the current state). Terminal-stage advance is also a no-op.

fn:cooking|cancel_session.doc: Abandon an active cook: set status -> 'cancelled' so it drops out of ``get_active_sessions`` (which filters status == 'active'). The dish-history ledger is untouched — a cancelled cook simply never produced a CookedMealCreated.

fn:cooking|clear_pending_cooking_timer_n.doc: Hard-delete any still-PENDING (``due_at`` in the future) cooking-timer notification for a session — called on timer start/replace/clear and on session complete/cancel. A delivered/past row (``due_at`` <= now) is left untouched; it accumulates in the inbox like any other notification. Returns the count deleted.

fn:cooking|complete_session.doc: Atomic completion: session + dish history + ingredient consumption.

fn:cooking|concurrent_cook_cap_for_tier.doc: Max concurrent ACTIVE sessions for this tier; unknown/None → the free cap (fail-closed).

fn:cooking|count_active_sessions.doc: How many ACTIVE cooking sessions this user has in flight — the concurrent-cook cap (ONE bucket, H6) counts against this. Per-user (sessions are user-scoped); no recipe/household join needed.

fn:cooking|delete_photo.doc: Delete one photo — active, owned sessions only; a missing slot raises.

fn:cooking|delete_session_photo.doc: Delete one cook photo. Active, owned sessions only; a missing slot 404s.

fn:cooking|delete_session_photos.doc: Wipe every photo for a session — the cancel hook (``services.cooking.cancel_session`` calls this). A cancelled cook's photos die with it; a COMPLETED cook keeps its photos (dish history reaches them via session_id) — never call this from the complete path.

fn:cooking|due_stage_reminders.doc: Pending stage reminders whose due_at has passed (the client's poll surface, SC-07).

fn:cooking|get_completed_step_ids.doc: Map each session id → the recipe_step_ids it has marked completed (founder 2026-06-24).

fn:cooking|get_due_reminders.doc: Pending long-prep stage reminders past their due_at (the client polls this; SC-07).

fn:cooking|get_photo.doc: Fetch a photo's full row (including bytes) — any session status; a completed cook keeps its photos, reached via session_id from dish history.

fn:cooking|get_session_photo.doc: Return the raw photo bytes. Any session status — a completed cook keeps its photos (dish history reaches them via session_id). Honors If-None-Match against the photo's id (the ETag) -> 304 with no body when unchanged.

fn:cooking|list_dish_history.doc: Return ``(page, total)`` of the user's cooked dishes, newest first.

fn:cooking|list_photo_refs.doc: Grouped photo METADATA for the given sessions — ONE query, never N+1 (mirrors ``get_completed_step_ids``). The ``data`` column is never selected (``load_only``) so a list read never pulls photo bytes. Caller has already authorized these session ids; user_id/household_id are still applied defensively (D136).

fn:cooking|mark_read.doc: Mark notifications as read. Returns count updated.

fn:cooking|patch_session_timer.doc: Start/replace or clear a session's per-step timer (H7). Ownership scoped exactly like step-progress (user_id + household_id + status active in one query) — a stranger's or inactive session 404s. A mixed body (one of step_id/duration_seconds null) 422s at the schema layer (SessionTimerRequest).

fn:cooking|post_advance_stage.doc: Advance a long-prep session to the next stage (REQ-16). Optimistically concurrent on ``expected_stage`` so a retry/double-tap can't skip a stage.

fn:cooking|post_cancel.doc: Abandon an active cook (status -> 'cancelled'); it drops out of GET /cooking/active. Ownership-scoped + idempotent. No dish history / no CookedMealCreated is produced. H8: cancel_session wipes the session's photos (delete_session_photos) in the same transaction, so the refs fetched below come back empty.

fn:cooking|put_session_photo.doc: Upload/replace one cook photo. RAW binary body (no multipart) — the Content-Type header IS the photo's mime type. A re-upload of the same slot REPLACES the row in place (never a second row) and never counts against the per-session cap. Response code: 201 on a NEW slot, 200 on a replace. Active, owned sessions only (404 otherwise — house style for "not yours" mirrors the sibling session routes).

fn:cooking|refresh_profile_projection.doc: Recompute profile projection from dish history + creation requests.

fn:cooking|register_handlers.doc: Wire domain handlers onto the bus. Called once at app startup (idempotent).

fn:cooking|schedule_cooking_timer.doc: Schedule a "cooking timer finished" notification (H7). Hidden from GET /notifications until ``due_at`` passes (the due filter in :func:`list_notifications`); the client's due poll of the same endpoint surfaces it once cooked.

fn:cooking|seed_stage_schedule.doc: On session start for a staged recipe: set current_stage=0 + schedule stage 1's reminder. No-op (returns None) for a recipe with fewer than 2 stages (no between-stage interval).

fn:cooking|set_session_timer.doc: Start/replace or clear a session's per-step timer (H7, founder-locked 2026-07-08).

fn:cooking|update_readiness.doc: Merge a readiness patch (source selections / photo-ready / verified / log_draft / mode_preference) into the session; optionally update the planned_portions COLUMN (mid-cook portion changes persist too — wrap-up slice, founder 2026-07-09).

fn:cooking|update_stage.doc: Pause/continue a multi-day session. ``pause`` → stage='paused' (+ reminder); ``continue`` → stage='active' (reminder cleared). Only on a non-completed session.

fn:cooking|upsert_photo.doc: Create or replace the photo at ``(session_id, slot)``.

fn:legal-consent|_serialize.doc: Every mapped column of a row → a JSON-safe dict, keyed by its DB column name.

fn:legal-consent|delete_account.doc: Wipe every DB row owned by ``user_id`` (+ its household, if this was the last member).

fn:legal-consent|ensure_consent.doc: Record consent at the CURRENT policy version if the user hasn't already accepted it.

fn:legal-consent|get_account_export.doc: The user's complete data as a downloadable JSON bundle (L6).

fn:legal-consent|latest_consent.doc: The user's most recent consent record, or None if they never accepted.

fn:legal-consent|record_consent.doc: Append a new acceptance of ``policy_version`` for the user.

fn:pantry|_planned_required_ingredients.doc: Required (non-optional) ingredients across the household's planned recipes.

fn:pantry|_resolve_item_meta.doc: Best display_name + unit_code for a bare ingredient_code (most-recent purchase, else a planned-recipe ingredient, else the code itself).

fn:pantry|add_candidate_to_list.doc: Add a frequent/suggested candidate to the pending list.

fn:pantry|apply_reset.doc: Atomic reset apply — processes all decisions in one transaction.

fn:pantry|assign_location.doc: Assign a pantry item to a location (removes it from the no-location projection).

fn:pantry|build_match_corpus.doc: Three reads → an immutable MatchCorpus: canonical ingredients (code + display_es), their aliases grouped by canonical code, and app-catalog recipe titles (slug IS NOT NULL).

fn:pantry|compute_cookability_summary.doc: Return ``(cookable_count, catalog_total)`` for the pantry overview (F1.1).

fn:pantry|compute_recipe_availability.doc: Return ``{recipe_id: (total_required, missing_count)}`` for the given recipes.

fn:pantry|confirm_bought.doc: Atomic bought confirmation: shopping→bought + pantry item + history.

fn:pantry|create_pantry_items_batch.doc: Create many confirmed pantry items in ONE transaction (Phase 58, D101).

fn:pantry|delete_location.doc: Delete a location. Returns True if deleted. Raises PrincipalLocationError for principal.

fn:pantry|delete_pantry_item.doc: Soft-delete a pantry item with a reason. Returns (item, history_logged) or None if the item does not exist in this household.

fn:pantry|delete_pantry_item_route.doc: Soft-delete a single pantry item with a reason (Phase 53, D98).

fn:pantry|frequent_candidates.doc: Most-bought ingredients (compra history) not currently in pantry or pending.

fn:pantry|generate_from_planned_recipes.doc: Create pending shopping items for planned-recipe ingredients the household lacks.

fn:pantry|get_frequent_ingredients.doc: The household's most-frequently-added canonical ingredients (batch-add quick-pick strip).

fn:pantry|get_pantry_ingredient_codes.doc: Household pantry ingredient codes available for recipe matching (Phase 13 T4).

fn:pantry|list_frequent_ingredients.doc: The household's most-FREQUENTLY-added canonical ingredients (batch-add quick-pick strip).

fn:pantry|list_history.doc: Return paginated history events. Returns (events, total_count, has_more).

fn:pantry|preview_reset.doc: Return pantry items in scope for a reset (no mutation).

fn:pantry|reconcile_planned_shopping.doc: Re-derive the auto (source='planned') gap shopping for the CURRENT planned set (REQ-15).

fn:pantry|resolve_batch.doc: Resolve raw typed lines to ranked canonical candidates + confidence (deterministic matcher).

fn:pantry|suggested_candidates.doc: Planned-recipe required ingredients the household lacks (gap preview).

fn:progression|_category_map.doc: ``ingredient_code → category_code`` (D4-B rollup) for the given codes — unknown codes are silently absent (pre-reconciliation ingredients, D72).

fn:progression|_compute_kind_stats.doc: One ledger scan → ``{kind: {code: (distinct cooked-session count, latest occurred_at)}}`` across all five trees. Facts merge snapshot-over-live PER FIELD (roast M4 / #35; the fallback also covers diet for snapshots written before diet_codes existed, and ingredients for pre-0037). ``restrict`` (per-cook) limits each kind to the cook's codes; ``None`` (backfill) keeps all.

fn:progression|_cooked_recipe_facts.doc: The live facts of the cooked recipe — the nodes THIS cook touches across trees (roast M3).

fn:progression|_cooked_recipe_skills.doc: The (kind, code) skills the cooked recipe exercises — its techniques + ingredients.

fn:progression|_distinct_session_counts.doc: Count DISTINCT cooked sessions in the user's dish-history involving each skill.

fn:progression|_nodes_for_codes.doc: The ``{code: TreeNode}`` of tree ``kind`` for the codes (empty if the tree isn't seeded).

fn:progression|_seed_one_tree.doc: Idempotent upsert of one tree + its nodes. Returns the node count ensured.

fn:progression|_upsert_node_progress.doc: High-water-mark upsert of ``node_progress`` for ``nodes`` from ``stats`` — the single source of truth for the PROG-001 rule, shared by the per-cook recompute and the per-user backfill.

fn:progression|backfill_node_progress_on.doc: Read-cutover + Phase-5 precondition: recompute ``node_progress`` for every user with cook history so the profile tier (derived from node_progress) doesn't floor for pre-EXPAND users, and so the new region/diet/ingredient trees populate for existing users. DEPLOY-ONLY (skipped on LOCAL + SQLite; tests call the per-user recompute directly), advisory-locked so replica boots serialize, NON-FATAL, idempotent (high-water-mark). Runs AFTER the tree seed + the sandbox seed so it picks up freshly seeded cooks. MVP-scale O(users × ledger); at scale → a one-time job.

fn:progression|build_profile_summary.doc: Compute the Perfil landing aggregate for a setup-complete user.

fn:progression|build_score_input.doc: Project one already-loaded ``Recipe`` row + its ``(total_required, missing)`` availability tuple into the pure scorer's ``ScoreInput``. No query — reuses the row + the route's tuple.

fn:progression|credits_summary.doc: (allowance, remaining) for the subscription surface (/me, /settings, /profile/summary). Remaining floors at 0 (concurrency overshoot can exceed it).

fn:progression|credits_used_this_month.doc: SUM(credits_charged) for one user over the current calendar month.

fn:progression|current_spend.doc: Total recorded AI cost (USD) since ``since`` — the rolling-window sum for the cap.

fn:progression|load_user_match_context.doc: The per-request user context: proficiency tier + per-technique decayed cook counts + cooked cuisines. Two queries total (node progress + the cooked ledger) — assembled ONCE per request.

fn:progression|on_cooked_meal_created.doc: Event handler (D-GU7): update the skill ledger when a meal is cooked.

fn:progression|recompute_all_node_progre.doc: Recompute ``node_progress`` for EVERY node the user has cooked, across all five trees — the backfill for users whose cooks predate the engine (or a newly-added tree). Idempotent high-water-mark upsert (same PROG-001 rule). Returns the number of nodes upserted.

fn:progression|recompute_node_progress_f.doc: Recompute ``node_progress`` for the nodes THIS cook touches across all five trees — from the full ledger, never incremented (roast M2/M3, D125). Returns the number of nodes upserted.

fn:progression|recompute_skills_for_cook.doc: Recompute the cooked recipe's skills from the ledger + upsert SkillProgress.

fn:progression|record_spend.doc: Record one real call's cost + credit charge (D95). No-op when BOTH cost <= 0 AND credits <= 0 (the mock lane stays row-free → cap + credits never trip), but a real call whose token counts round to $0 still records its credit — credits never infer from cost. BEST-EFFORT (savepoint + swallow, like enqueue_unknown_ingredients — review must-fix): the Gemini call already succeeded + cost money, so a record failure must NOT 500 the recipe — that would lose a billed result AND make the retry double-bill (worse than a bounded one-call undercount). The CHECK side (assert_under_spend_cap / assert_credits_available) stays fail-closed; only this WRITE side is best-effort.

fn:progression|seed_progression_trees.doc: Idempotent upsert of ALL five progression trees + their nodes. Returns the total node count. Zero authored content — the nodes ARE the taxonomy/catalog (roast M5).

fn:progression|seed_progression_trees_on.doc: Boot reconcile of the progression trees — DEPLOY-ONLY (skipped on LOCAL + SQLite; tests seed explicitly), advisory-locked so replica boots serialize, NON-FATAL (never crash-loops boot).

fn:progression|subscription_tier_for.doc: The user's subscription tier; ``free`` when no entitlement row exists yet.

fn:recipe|ExplorationBias.from_lists.doc: Build a bias from the raw stored fields, expanding each declared region to its member origin codes so a region pref matches both the region code itself and its countries (mirrors the ``region=`` browse-facet member-set semantics, D96-rev). The three Path A+ fields default empty / ``None`` so the original 2-arg call stays valid; the three SENS-surface sensory fields are keyword-only and default ``None`` so every existing call site (and the empty-bias degradation to today's behavior) is unchanged.

fn:recipe|_finalize_stream.doc: Add (if new) + write the creation request, then COMMIT — called ONLY at a terminal result, so a cancelled stream persists nothing (M5). Two commits land on this one request-scoped session (auth upserted the user, then this); ``expire_on_commit=False`` (db.py) keeps objects usable across both. On a concurrent same-key insert (the #27 race) the unique constraint trips — roll back and REPLAY the winner, never crash. Resolves candidates for surfacing + enqueues unknowns before commit (#39 / D72). ``charge`` (D95): True only when the provider RAN (completed | no_novel); the deferred path passes False so a not-wired provider never charges credits.

fn:recipe|_load_preferred_tokens.doc: The user's soft food-preference tokens (UserDietaryProfile.preferences), or empty.

fn:recipe|_query_domain.doc: Query a specific catalog domain and return typed items.

fn:recipe|_raise_for_pipeline_error.doc: Map a typed pipeline error to its HTTP status (ProviderNotWiredError is handled in the service as a deferred result, so it never reaches here).

fn:recipe|_required_and_all_codes.doc: One query → ({recipe_id: NON-OPTIONAL codes} for coverage/gap, {recipe_id: ALL codes} for the novelty element set). Constant query count regardless of recipe count (no N+1).

fn:recipe|_sse_frames.doc: Frame each event for SSE, emitting a keep-alive comment every ``_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS`` of silence so a real-Gemini inter-stage gap (≈2-5s, longer under load) can't trip a proxy/edge IDLE timeout that would drop the connection (#30). SSE comment frames (``:`` prefix) are ignored by EventSource.

fn:recipe|apply_recipe_filters.doc: Apply the shared WHERE/JOIN clauses for a recipe listing onto ``query``.

fn:recipe|archive_orphan_recipes.doc: Deploy-time recipe-SET sync (removal half): ARCHIVE any SYSTEM recipe whose slug is no longer in the catalog — status ``active`` → ``archived``, which the browse filters out (the ``Recipe.status == "active"`` predicate in services.recipes). SOFT on purpose — never hard-deletes, so a user's favorites, cooked history, and any in-flight cook survive (a hard delete CASCADEs those). Scoped to ``creator_type='system'`` + a non-NULL slug so AI/user recipes are never touched. Idempotent (an already-archived orphan won't re-match). Returns the number archived. Empty catalog → no-op (a guard against archiving the whole catalog if the in-image files ever fail to load).

fn:recipe|assert_recipe_allergen_safe.doc: Raise AllergenConflictError if a STORED recipe is unsafe for the user (#38 / R8).

fn:recipe|attach_cupo.doc: Attach a dish type to the user's own saved-mode row, making that slot a cupo.

fn:recipe|build_cooked_ledger.doc: Build the familiarity baseline from the user's cooked-dish history.

fn:recipe|cocinadas_for_cupo.doc: DERIVED: COUNT of THIS user's cooks of the dish type over the cooking log (D187 R3).

fn:recipe|create_missing_recipes.doc: Deploy-time recipe-SET sync: CREATE any catalog recipe whose slug is not yet in the DB, so a newly-authored curated recipe reaches a deployed env WITHOUT a manual reseed. Create-ONLY (a CHANGED existing recipe is `sync_changed_recipes`' job). Assumes ``files`` is already validated (the boot path validates first). Returns the number of recipes created.

fn:recipe|create_mode.doc: Create a mode for the user, rejecting the write when it would exceed ``max_slots``.

fn:recipe|create_recipe_manual.doc: Create a recipe from manual input. Idempotent via creation request.

fn:recipe|delete_cupo.doc: Release the CUPO, keep the slot (D183: nothing earned is lost — counters derive).

fn:recipe|delete_mode.doc: Delete a slot. User-scoped → another household member cannot delete it (D136).

fn:recipe|delete_plan_recipe.doc: Remove a recipe from the household's Planeadas — the recipe-scoped inverse of ``POST /recipes/{id}/plan`` (the "Quitar del plan" popup action, U4). Deletes every manual PlannedRecipe row for this recipe in the household. IDEMPOTENT: an already-unplanned recipe returns 204 too (0 rows removed) — no 404 — so a double-tap or a stale UI never errors.

fn:recipe|e2e_seed.doc: Idempotently seed the authenticated test user's setup graph.

fn:recipe|e2e_seed_catalogs.doc: Idempotently seed all reference catalog tables for E2E tests.

fn:recipe|explore_recipes.doc: Novelty post-filter (REQ-09/D-GU2): recipes that introduce exactly one novel element for ``mode``, over the user's cooked-meal ledger. Composes the D-GU3 order — allergen hard-filter FIRST, then novelty. NOTE: this route MUST be declared before ``/recipes/{recipe_id}`` so 'explore' is not parsed as an id.

fn:recipe|filter_candidates.doc: Keep only candidates that pass the one-novel-element rule for ``mode``.

fn:recipe|generate_gustify_recipe.doc: Run the D-GU3 pipeline for a Gustify AI suggestion. Idempotent on the key. ``model_tier`` (D95) picks the Gemini tier: lite (default, 1 credit) | full (3).

fn:recipe|generate_weekly_plan.doc: Generate + persist a deterministic weekly plan (Option C) and its gap-only shopping.

fn:recipe|get_catalog.doc: Return all items for a catalog domain.

fn:recipe|get_cupos.doc: The user's cupos with derived planeadas/cocinadas, plus the shared slot cap.

fn:recipe|get_current.doc: The latest generated weekly plan + its current pending gap shopping. 404 if none.

fn:recipe|get_current_plan.doc: The latest generated weekly-plan batch (most recent plan_generated_at) + the current pending gap shopping. None if no plan has ever been generated for the household.

fn:recipe|get_equipment.doc: The caller's owned equipment + the full valid vocabulary (for the UI toggle list).

fn:recipe|get_exploration_preferences.doc: Read the user's exploration row, or ``None`` when absent (= empty/default).

sig.returns: tuple[Recipe, list[RecipeIngredient], list[RecipeStep], list[RecipeNote], list[RecipeEquipment]] | None

fn:recipe|get_taxonomy.doc: Return the full taxonomy tree (dimensions + values).

fn:recipe|get_user_cooked_recipe_ids.doc: Return the subset of ``recipe_ids`` the user has cooked (F2 per-recipe ``cooked`` field).

fn:recipe|get_user_equipment_codes.doc: The set of equipment codes the user OWNS (H5 kitchen inventory) — feeds the ``equipment_available`` recipe filter + the GET /equipment inventory read.

fn:recipe|get_user_flags_map.doc: Return ``{recipe_id: (favorite, archived)}`` for the user's flag rows (D93).

fn:recipe|ingredient_allergen_exclusions.doc: Build INGREDIENT-DERIVED allergen exclusions for stored recipes (#38 / R8).

fn:recipe|ingredient_exclusion_condition.doc: Build INGREDIENT-EXCLUSION conditions (D108 / Workstream B): drop any recipe that CONTAINS a banned ingredient — the "no considerar" (red) state of the 5-slot picker.

fn:recipe|ingredient_inclusion_condition.doc: Build INGREDIENT-INCLUSION conditions (D108 / Workstream B): keep only recipes that CONTAIN each requested ingredient.

fn:recipe|iter_candidate_recipes.doc: Yield ALL active, allergen-safe recipes in keyset batches (#26 explore-cap fix).

fn:recipe|list_cupos.doc: The user's cupo-bearing modes with both DERIVED counters, slot order (oldest first).

fn:recipe|list_modes.doc: The user's modes, oldest first (stable slot order — the client maps array index → slot).

fn:recipe|list_recipes.doc: List recipes (one page) with taxonomy filters, D17 allergen exclusion, and per-user archived/favorite filtering (D93/D84). Returns ``(page, total)`` where ``total`` is the count of ALL matching recipes ignoring ``limit``/``offset``.

fn:recipe|load_user_allergens.doc: Load a user's allergen codes from their dietary profile (D17 R8).

fn:recipe|match_score.doc: The recipe's match score for a mode, as a 0-100 integer. Unknown mode → the default lens.

fn:recipe|max_slots_for_tier.doc: Slot cap for a subscription tier; unknown/None tiers fail closed to the free cap (1).

fn:recipe|patch_recipe_flags.doc: UPSERT the caller's per-user favorite/archived flags for a recipe (D93).

fn:recipe|plan_into_cupo.doc: Plan a suggested recipe into a cupo — stamps ``cupo_id`` + ``planned_by_user_id``.

fn:recipe|plan_recipe.doc: ``cupo_id`` (F6, D187): the saved-mode slot this plan was made through — stamped so planeadas derives from the link; None is the pre-F6 manual plan, unchanged.

fn:recipe|planeadas_for_cupo.doc: DERIVED: COUNT of active PlannedRecipes linked to this cupo (contract §Counters).

fn:recipe|post_create_gustify.doc: Generate AI recipe suggestions via the D-GU3 pipeline (REQ-08 structure).

fn:recipe|post_generate_plan.doc: Generate a deterministic weekly plan from the current pantry + allergen profile + novelty, returning the plan and its gap-only shopping list (SC-05). Regenerating replaces the prior generated batch. An empty/under-filled corpus returns a capped 201, never 500.

fn:recipe|post_recipe_demand.doc: Capture a 0-result recipe search as DEMAND ("Pedir recetas", founder 2026-06-22). Records the unmet search criteria + the optional ≤140-char note for later on-demand authoring — NO recipe is generated here. Household is context-only (None when the user has no household yet).

fn:recipe|post_relief_accept.doc: Filter-relief continue: re-run relaxing the novelty rule (allergen safety stays). Real generation still returns the deferred shape (PENDING #22).

fn:recipe|put_cupo.doc: Attach (or overwrite) the dish type on an owned slot, making it a cupo.

fn:recipe|put_equipment.doc: Wholesale-replace the caller's owned equipment set. Fails LOUD (400) on an unknown code — a typo must never silently drop a piece of gear (mirrors the recipe-facet fail-loud contract). Duplicate codes in the body collapse to a set. PUT is idempotent — no Idempotency-Key.

fn:recipe|recipe_cooked_by_user.doc: Per-recipe cooked-state for the DETAIL response (F2 ``cooked`` field).

fn:recipe|recipe_planned_by_household.doc: Per-recipe planned-state for the DETAIL response (U4 ``planned`` field).

fn:recipe|reclaim_if_abandoned.doc: Reset an ABANDONED (PENDING past CLAIM_TTL) creation-request claim in place, exactly like services/idempotency.py's ``claim()`` does for the generic model. This ad hoc scheme (keyed by ``uq_recipe_creation_user_key``, not the ``IdempotencyKey`` table) shares the SAME TTL contract via ``is_claim_abandoned`` instead of drifting its own — the poison a mid-flight provider failure used to leave behind (a permanently-"pending" row that every replay re-attempted with no escape hatch; journey suite 2026-07-09).

fn:recipe|record_spend_for.doc: Record a real call's $ cost (#41) + credit charge (D95). Credits charge ONLY when the REAL provider ran (never inferred from cost — a $0-rounding real call still charges); mock/fixture lanes write nothing (cost 0 + credits 0 → skipped). ``charge=False`` (relief-accept, deferred) meters USD but charges 0 credits.

fn:recipe|release_cupo.doc: Release the CUPO, keep the slot: clears the dish type, the mode survives as a plain saved query. Nothing earned is lost — both counters derive from rows this doesn't touch.

fn:recipe|relief_accept.doc: Filter-relief continue: re-run the pipeline relaxing novelty (NOT allergen safety).

fn:recipe|rerank_by_preferences.doc: Stable re-rank: float the recipes matching the user's bias to the top (D109 Path A).

fn:recipe|search_recipes.doc: Search recipes with D17 allergen exclusion + taxonomy filters + per-user flags.

fn:recipe|seed_all_catalogs.doc: Seed all reference catalog tables. Returns counts per domain.

fn:recipe|seed_catalogs_on_startup.doc: Idempotently seed ALL reference catalogs on deploy (#40 / D75). Reuses seed_all_catalogs under a Postgres transaction-level advisory lock so concurrent replica boots serialize (the env.py migration pattern). DEPLOY-ONLY — skipped on LOCAL + SQLite (tests seed explicitly). NON-FATAL — a failure logs loudly but never crash-loops boot (post-D70 boot philosophy); the row-count check (assert_allergen_seed_present + per-env verify) catches an empty catalog. Reference data evolves, so this reconciles the DB to the CURRENT taxonomy on every deploy rather than freezing it in a migration.

fn:recipe|seed_ingredient_restrictions.doc: Seed the ingredient→allergen-restriction join table from ``starter_ingredients[].violates`` (#38 / R8). Idempotent — an existing (ingredient, restriction) pair is skipped. Returns the number of pairs in the taxonomy.

fn:recipe|seed_recipe_sensory.doc: Apply the authored sensory profiles to recipe rows by slug. Returns the number of recipes actually updated (a slug absent from the DB contributes 0). Idempotent — re-running re-sets the same values. Testable: tests call this directly with a session.

fn:recipe|seed_recipe_sensory_on_startup.doc: Reconcile recipe sensory columns from ``data/catalog/sensory/*.json`` on deploy. Mirrors seed_catalogs_on_startup: DEPLOY-ONLY (skipped on LOCAL + SQLite — tests seed explicitly), advisory-locked so replica boots serialize, NON-FATAL (a failure logs but never crash-loops boot — the sensory note just stays absent until the next deploy).

fn:recipe|seed_safety_warnings.doc: Seed the curated food-safety warnings (Future-Features SAFE) into ``ingredient_warnings`` + ``contextual_warning_rules`` from ``reference/safety_warnings.py``. UPSERT (not skip-only): an existing (code, aviso_code[, state_tag]) row is UPDATED to match the source so founder edits to the content propagate on deploy; a missing row is inserted. Returns the total row count.

fn:recipe|set_user_equipment_codes.doc: Wholesale-replace the user's kitchen inventory with ``codes`` (allowlist-validated by the caller). Deletes rows for now-absent codes + inserts rows for newly-present ones (idempotent — unchanged codes stay). Returns the resulting owned set.

fn:recipe|stream_gustify.doc: SSE stream of the D-GU3 pipeline (REQ-10 web transport). Auth + idempotency key arrive as query params (EventSource has no header API). Pipeline failures arrive as ``error`` events in the stream, not HTTP statuses — the 200 status line is committed the moment streaming starts. Setup/auth pre-conditions still gate before the stream opens (401 invalid token via the dependency; 409 if setup incomplete). ``model_tier`` (D95, lite|full, default lite) is validated in the producer → ``invalid_request`` error event on a bad value.

fn:recipe|stream_gustify_events.doc: Stream the D-GU3 pipeline as events. Idempotent on the key (replay → a single ``result`` event); persists on COMPLETION ONLY so a mid-stream client disconnect leaves no partial row (architect roast M3/M5). ``model_tier`` (D95) picks the Gemini tier; invalid values surface as an ``invalid_request`` error event (both transports).

fn:recipe|sync_changed_recipes.doc: Deploy-time CONTENT sync: re-upsert an EXISTING catalog recipe when its stored ``content_hash`` differs from the catalog's current hash (a real content edit — steps, ingredients, title, complexity, …) OR when it was archived but is back in the catalog (re-activate). This is what carries a data edit to an existing recipe onto a deployed DB without a manual reseed. Cheap in steady state — an unchanged, active recipe is skipped with no writes; only the changed handful re-upsert. A mid-cook recipe is skipped (``upsert_recipe`` refuses the wholesale child-row replace while a session is active) and converges on a later deploy. On the FIRST deploy after 0052 every row has a NULL hash → each re-syncs once (idempotent — the DB already matches the catalog — then stays hashed). Assumes validated files. Returns ``(synced, skipped_active)``.

fn:recipe|unplan_recipe_by_recipe.doc: Remove a recipe from the household's Planeadas — the recipe-scoped inverse of ``plan_recipe`` (the "Quitar del plan" popup action, DELETE /recipes/{id}/plan).

fn:recipe|update_mode.doc: Replace a slot's contents (overwrite). User-scoped lookup → 404 if it isn't theirs.

fn:recipe|upsert_exploration_preferences.doc: Get-or-create the user's exploration row and set every bias field (flush, no commit).

fn:recipe|upsert_ingredient_deltas.doc: INSERT-ONLY canonical-ingredient + restriction-pair deltas (the D75 contract).

fn:recipe|upsert_recipe.doc: Upsert one recipe by slug (update-in-place). Returns "created" | "updated" | "skipped_active". An UPDATE is refused while the recipe has an active cooking session (review 47-1): the wholesale child-row replacement would CASCADE-delete the cook's step progress (cooking_step_progress.recipe_step_id ondelete=CASCADE). Skipped recipes converge on a later re-run once the session completes.

fn:recipe|upsert_recipe_flags.doc: UPSERT a user's favorite/archived flags for a recipe (D93). Returns the resulting ``(favorite, archived)``.

fn:recipe|valid_tipo_codes.doc: The taxonomy ``tipo`` codes (shared/taxonomy.json — the canonical dimension).

fn:settings|get_locale_bundle.doc: Resolve the user's locale (language + household country) and return its bundle.

fn:settings|patch_exploration.doc: D109 Path A — wholesale-replace the caller's two exploration bias lists.

det.doc: D108 dietary input — two sections: allergens[] (hard) + preferences[] (soft).
Household shared format defaults — serving must be an allowed value.
Notification category toggles (cooking, shopping, pantry).
Independent privacy toggles (shopping data, culinary prefs, reminders).
Everything a first-run user submits to finish setup and create their household.
User personal format preference — display language.

Advance a long-prep session. ``expected_stage`` is the stage the client believes the session is on — advancing is optimistically concurrent (a stale/retry value is a safe no-op replay), so a double-tap can't skip a stage.
Completion counters. ``actual_portions`` is the total cooked; ``portions_stored`` (0 ≤ stored ≤ actual) are set aside as a prepared pantry item, the rest eaten.
A cook-photo's metadata (H8 / D144) — NEVER the bytes. GET the binary route (``/cooking/sessions/{id}/photos/{slot}``) for the actual image.
Paginated dish history (Phase 13 T1).
Source/photo readiness patch (Phase 14; photo upload storage deferred).

Start/replace or clear a session's per-step timer (H7, founder-locked 2026-07-08). ``step_id`` + ``duration_seconds`` BOTH set starts/replaces the timer; BOTH null clears it; a mixed body is rejected (422). The SERVER clock computes ``timer_ends_at`` — never trusts a client-supplied instant, so the countdown survives an app kill/reinstall.
A durable stage reminder for a long-prep session (SC-07).
Pause/continue a multi-day session (Phase 14). ``reminder_at`` is only meaningful with ``pause`` — supplying it on ``continue`` is rejected.
Acknowledgement for POST /account/export (Phase 15 stub).
Assign a pantry item to a storage location (Phase 15).
One ranked canonical candidate a typed line could map to.
One confirmed row to create. Mirrors PantryItemCreate but is collected in a batch; the row must carry a resolved canonical code (pick-or-drop guarantees this — no unverified rows).
Per-row outcome: the created item (on success) or an error message (on failure). The index ties the result back to the request row so the client can report partial failures precisely.
A resolved input line: parsed quantity + ranked candidates + confidence band. `candidates` is empty when confidence is `low` (the UI forces pick-or-drop so the pantry stays canonical).
A canonical entry Gustify publishes for Boletapp's receipt-item picker.
Gustify `GET /api/v1/catalog` publish shape (ETag-cacheable per ADR).
Wraps a read that may be stale because the last sync was a while ago.
Connection + resilience config for the deferred live wiring.
One canonical ingredient the household adds often — feeds the batch-add quick-pick strip.
A non-persisted shopping suggestion (frequent or planned-recipe gap).
FLAT delete result (D84) — the new status + whether a history event was logged.
Pantry overview + the cookability summary (F1.1).
A request to ingest a user's receipt items into the household pantry.
Summary of an ingest run. mapped_pending = mapped items whose pantry append is DEFERRED until the wiring phase (D43).
One receipt line item published by Boletapp.
Boletapp `GET /boletapp/v1/users/{email}/receipt-items` response envelope.

Top-line counts for the Perfil landing history strip.
A taxonomy code (cuisine type / technique) with its cooked-dish count.
One learned skill on the home screen's 3-most-recent unlock list (REQ-14 / SC-04).

Per-tree mastery for the profile's progression breakdown (Phase 5, per-tree additive). One per progression tree (technique/region/diet/ingredient); ``technique`` is also the headline proficiency_tier. ``level`` is None when the user has no live progress in that tree.
Cooked-dish count for one ISO week, keyed by its Monday (YYYY-MM-DD).

A derived food-safety advisory for a recipe (Future-Features SAFE) — the SOFT "how not to mishandle" layer, DISTINCT from the hard allergen list (`restriction_codes`). `source_kind` drives the client provenance badge: 'official' shows the `source_ref` citation; 'ai_default' shows an AI-suggested disclosure. `state_tag` is null for intrinsic advisories, the prep state (e.g. 'crudo' / 'mal-cocido') for conditional ones.
PUT /recipe-filter-modes/{mode_id}/cupo body: the taxonomy ``tipo`` code to attach.
One cupo-bearing saved mode with both derived counters.
The user's cupos plus the tier-derived slot cap (ONE pool with Saved Modes, D186).

A pipeline-surfaced candidate (novelty + allergen filtered). Not persisted — structure-only until real generation lands (REQ-08, PENDING #22).

Body for ``POST /recipe-creation/gustify`` — the explore mode to generate for. ``model_tier`` (D95) picks the Gemini tier: lite (default, flash-lite, 1 credit) | full (flash, 3 credits). Additive with a default → OpenAPI stays additive.
Result of an AI generation attempt (D-GU3 pipeline).
Per-call cost/latency/tokens for one AI generation (REQ-19). Structure-only today (mock provider → cost 0, fixture tokens, real measured latency).
Optional POST /recipes/{id}/plan body (F6, additive): the cupo slot this plan is made through. Omitted/None = the pre-F6 manual plan, unchanged.
Pantry-availability projection for a recipe (Phase 13 T4).
POST body for capturing a 0-result search demand ("Pedir recetas", 2026-06-22).
Acknowledgement of a captured demand (the row is fulfilled later, off-band).
One critical piece of equipment a recipe needs (Phase 9 / SCHEMA-ENRICH).
The resulting per-user flags after a PATCH (D93).
PATCH body for per-user recipe flags (D93). Only the provided fields are set; an omitted (None) field leaves the existing value untouched (partial update).

One long-prep stage (#69 / REQ-16). ``hold_hours`` = the minimum wait after ENTERING this stage before the next is due — the exact shape ``services/long_prep.py`` reads (label ≤ 120 = the reminder column width; hold clamped 0..8760 = the reader's one-year cap).
One generated-recipe ingredient resolved against the canonical catalog (#39 / D72).
